reviews.t: I highly recommend giving this a try if you have any skin ...
reviews.x: I have been searching for a deodorant that I can wear that won't cause a rash or irritation, and after several years, I finally came across this from a recommendation of a dermatologist. I have ezcema, psoriasis and a fragrance and beeswax allergy-- so my choices are limited. I highly recommend giving this a try if you have any skin issues and further, it actually works, in terms of keeping sweating/odor under control.

When applying the pit paste, some of the product falls from my armpit to the floor before I can rub it in.

reviews.t: No rash, no stink, no wetness... the best natural deodorant for me!!!!
reviews.x: I have tried at least 10 different natural deodorants, including my own recipes. With each new product I would research, people would say "it's the best!", but I was sorely disappointed many times. I've decided that every person's chemistry is different, so while this one worked for me, it might not work for others. All my previous attempts at going natural either left me with an itchy rash, constant moistness, stinky pits, the need to be applied every 2-3 hours, or was messy (powders).

claims.text: Many reviewers find it effective at controlling odor, some for up to 24 hours.
Several reviewers say it works well for sensitive skin and avoids rashes or irritation.
Some reviewers report it did not work for them, causing odor or skin problems like rashes or infection.
Reviewers mention the texture can be gritty or awkward to apply with fingers or a stick.
Some note an adjustment or 'detox' period with temporary odor before the body adjusts.
